full_page.content:
1934, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 214
Aug. Margaret Nestor- 27 - fears operation. Had four operations on groth with results - came and Enrolled in Ser. Mass A. and got O.K.
Mrs. Mary McDonald Josephine -- John Nowinski - 35 - drunkn's
Page 215
Blank Page
Page 216
Aug. A.J. Catellier - Chicago - 45 - asthma - Hay-Fev.
Willard Thibodeau - 35 - Throat trouble - perfectly recovered eight yrs ago from loss of kidney and bladder. Doctors still in amazement that nothing seem wanting to his physical condition - At time of operation was enrolled in Ser. Mass Assoc'n by mother for yr. Is enrolled for year again To-day by anxious father.
Mrs. Cath Swan - husband big mason - once methodist - poor speci- men (even) "Expects at death ... simply to go to hell.
Allen Stevenson - 17 - fractured Knee-cartilege, father believes in God but not in the hear-after ..! nor Drs. - Except when sick.
(under Feb. 24, 1932) Joseph Fr. Barry - 2 yr. & 8 mo. - never tried to sit up or stand, parents to H. Com. monthly - Enrolled when 2 months old for Eyes (5.00) -doctors had no hope at time he'd ever see. Eyes appeared 8 month ago - improving - enrolled again to-day.
Page 217 Aug. Mrs. Leona Kline - 40 - Quincey, Ill. - threatening. . . . has 4 chil- dren ....
Frank Kuczynski - 76 - cancer of throat.
Page 218 Aug. 26 26 Rose Markley - 80 last New Years - had diabetis & gangreenous foot. Drs. wanted to amputate leg. Prayed for her in January - at the time-now home but without toes on one foot ....
Mrs. Cath Ames - 44 - widow 3 yrs. - 5 children to care for - can- cer colon.
